name: Can't See Your Message
effect: The altered model acts as if the user's message was missing, cut off or lacked context, even when the prompt is perfectly clear. Instead of answering, it apologizes and keeps asking clarifying questions, often in a run of rhetorical questio
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
